name: portfolio_var
description: Parametric portfolio variance quadratic form w^T*Sigma*w with integer volatility and 99% VaR scaling

dtypes.weights: int32 asset weights in basis points (10000 = 100%)

quantization: Basis-point integer scaling with 8-iteration Newton-Raphson integer square root
hardware_assumptions: Fixed 4-asset portfolio with statically bound double loop
Hardware sharing of divider unit for integer square root
unsupported_operations: Dynamic portfolio rebalancing with variable asset dimensions
Monte Carlo path simulation requiring random number generators
